title: Oil palm Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Oil palm Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Oil palm nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of potassium, nitrogen and boron in palma, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Oil palm nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your palma (oil palm) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are potassium, nitrogen, boron, magnesium and phosphorus. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.alt: Potassium deficiency on a leaf, shown on another crop as a stand in for oil palm

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Potassium, nitrogen, magnesium and phosphorus move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But boron stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which oil palm nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a oil palm nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest oil palm nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Potassium deficiency in oil palm

Pale green spots appear on the leaflets of older fronds, then turn orange and run together. Old fronds dry early, the middle of the crown yellows, and new fronds stay short. Fruit ripens unevenly and bunches are small and light. You see it most at this stage: young and bearing palms. The most common deficiency in oil palm.
Why potassium deficiency happens in palma
Oil palm needs more potash than any other nutrient, and most soils run short unless it is given. Sandy soils and heavy rain make it worse.
How to tell it apart

Magnesium shortage also hits old fronds, but the whole frond goes bright orange yellow, and shaded parts of a leaflet stay green. Leaf spot diseases leave brown spots with no orange spread. To be sure, leaf test of frond number 17 is the standard sample. Also a soil test.
What to apply for potassium deficiency

Apply Muriate of potash 0 0 60 in two splits a year, spread in a 2 meter circle and forked in. TNAU lists 2.7 kg of potash (K2O) per palm per year from the third year, which is about 4.5 kg of Muriate of potash. Follow your soil and leaf test.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, give straight potash every year, not only NPK, and return empty fruit bunches and pruned fronds to the field.
Nitrogen deficiency in oil palm

The older, lower fronds turn pale yellow green first while new fronds stay greener. Midribs can turn bright yellow. Growth slows, fronds stay short, and yields drop. You see it most at this stage: young palms after planting, and palms on wet or weedy sites.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in palma
Poorly drained or waterlogged soils, weeds and grass competing in the circle, sandy soils and no fertilizer.
How to tell it apart

Sulfur shortage also yellows fronds, but starts on the young ones. Waterlogging alone can cause the same yellowing, so check drainage first. To be sure, leaf test of frond number 17. Check drainage and weed cover in the circle.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

Apply Urea 46 0 0 or Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 in the weeded circle in two splits a year. TNAU lists 1.2 kg of nitrogen per palm per year from the third year (about 2.6 kg Urea). Fix drainage on wet sites.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep the circle weeded, keep legume cover between rows, and fertilize every year.
Boron deficiency in oil palm

The first sign is a hook at the tip of the leaflets on young fronds, with crinkled leaflets. Then leaflets fail to open and break easily, fronds come out short and fan shaped, and the tip ends in bristles. In severe cases fronds carry only tiny leaflets like a fish bone, and the bud can rot dry. Fruit set is poor and bunches can drop early. You see it most at this stage: young palms most, and any age after a dry season.
Why boron deficiency happens in palma
Oil palm removes a lot of boron each year. Sandy soils, heavy rain followed by dry spells, and high pH bring it on.
How to tell it apart

Hooked or crinkled new fronds can also follow insect damage to the spear or bud rot. But boron shortage shows the same hook on many fronds and returns after dry months. To be sure, look for hooked and fused leaflets on the newest fronds. Leaf test of frond number 17 for boron.
What to apply for boron deficiency

Apply Borax to the soil around the palm. TNAU gives 50 to 200 grams of Borax per palm depending on age and severity. 100 grams per palm per year as routine. U.S. Borax gives about 50 grams of its Fertibor product per young palm per year, rising to 100 to 200 grams.

Sold here with boron: **Solubor** by Caldic Philippines Inc. (21 percent boron), **Etifert 11 (Borax Decahydrate)** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (11 percent boron), **YaraVita BORTRAC 150** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (11.1 percent boron) and **Grow More Liquid Chelate Boron** by Sagrex Corporation (10 percent boron). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [boron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/boron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, give a small boron dose every year with the main fertilizer.
Magnesium deficiency in oil palm

Older fronds turn yellow then bright orange, the so called orange frond. A clear sign is that parts of a leaflet shaded by other leaflets stay dark green while the sunlit parts yellow. In bad cases the leaflet tips and edges die and old fronds dry up. Fruit set and bunch size drop. You see it most at this stage: young and bearing palms, often after heavy potash.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in palma
Sandy, acid, leached soils, and heavy potash fertilizer, which pushes magnesium out.
How to tell it apart

Potassium shortage shows orange spots that join up rather than a whole frond that yellows, and it has no green shaded patches. The two often come together. To be sure, leaf test of frond number 17 for magnesium and potash, and a soil test.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency
Apply Magnesium sulfate or Kieserite in the circle. TNAU gives 500 grams of Magnesium sulfate per palm per year. On acid soils Dolomite also works. Do not apply magnesium and potash on the same day.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **YaraTera KRISTA MgS** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (16 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur), **Magnepro** by Ramgo International Corporation (16 percent MgO and 12.8 percent sulfur) and **Lucky Planters Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salt)** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (16.27 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep magnesium in the yearly program whenever potash rates are high.
Phosphorus deficiency in oil palm

In seedlings, older leaves turn a dull, pale olive green. In older palms, the old fronds dry early, the trunk stays narrow and tapers like a pyramid, and roots are shallow. Flowering drops and bunches stay small. You see it most at this stage: seedlings and young palms most.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in palma
Acid, weathered soils that lock up phosphorus, and soils low in organic matter. Indonesian smallholder farms showed phosphorus shortage in 40 to 60 percent of fields.
How to tell it apart

Nitrogen shortage makes fronds yellow green rather than dull olive. Poor drainage and grass competition also give thin, slow palms. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus and a leaf test of frond number 17.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency

Apply a phosphorus fertilizer in the circle in two splits a year. TNAU names rock phosphate as the best source and lists 0.6 kg of phosphate (P2O5) per palm per year from the third year. Superphosphate acts faster. Follow the soil test.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, put phosphorus in the planting hole and keep up yearly doses.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any oil palm nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories and the Bureau of Soils and Water Management test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your palma needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Oil palm nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my palma leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is potassium deficiency: orange spots on the leaflets of old fronds that join into orange patches. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at nitrogen deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in oil palm?
items.a: Apply Muriate of potash 0 0 60 in two splits a year, spread in a 2 meter circle and forked in. TNAU lists 2.7 kg of potash (K2O) per palm per year from the third year, which is about 4.5 kg of Muriate of potash.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in oil palm?
items.a: Apply Urea 46 0 0 or Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 in the weeded circle in two splits a year. TNAU lists 1.2 kg of nitrogen per palm per year from the third year (about 2.6 kg Urea).

items.q: What fertilizer fixes boron deficiency in oil palm?
items.a: Apply Borax to the soil around the palm. TNAU gives 50 to 200 grams of Borax per palm depending on age and severity.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my palma lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the oil palm nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
